transcript.text: Alright, let's get the weekly access-control review started. We've got the passkey-authentication rollout for the internal administrator console scheduled for Monday at 09:00. Before I can approve the production rollout plan, I need to go through the checklist with each of you individually. I'll call on the identity platform lead, IT operations lead, and compliance engineer one at a time. Each of you will need to state any rollout-impacting findings, the exact plan changes you require, and the follow-up you'll own. I won't approve the plan until each role has completed that check-in. Let's start with the identity platform lead — what findings do you have?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: While testing an unrelated mobile-device enrollment issue this morning, I confirmed that 23 legacy mobile clients cannot complete the passkey ceremony. The identity platform team requires a 10% canary and a 14-day optional-mode period before enforcement. I have not updated the rollout ticket yet.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: While preparing the weekly administrator access roster, I confirmed that 18 contractor accounts do not receive their required hardware keys until Wednesday at 09:00. IT Operations must exclude those accounts from enrollment until that time, but I have not added the exception list to the rollout plan yet.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: During a control-evidence review this afternoon, I confirmed that privileged administrator authentication events must be kept in immutable storage for exactly 400 days. The current draft rollout keeps the standard 30-day audit-log retention, which does not meet this requirement. I have not yet opened the compliance ticket for this rollout. As compliance engineer, my required plan change is: the rollout plan must update audit-log retention for privileged administrator authentication events to 400 days in immutable storage before I can approve. I will own opening the compliance ticket and verifying the retention configuration is updated.
transcript.speaker: A4

commitments.detail: Update the rollout ticket with the 10% canary and 14-day optional-mode period before enforcement, reflecting the 23 legacy mobile clients that cannot complete the passkey ceremony.
Add the 18 contractor accounts to the rollout plan exception list, excluding them from enrollment until Wednesday at 09:00 when their hardware keys arrive.
Open the compliance ticket for this rollout and verify that privileged administrator authentication event audit-log retention is updated to 400 days in immutable storage before approval.
Do not approve the production rollout plan until all three follow-ups are completed and each role has confirmed their check-in per the review checklist.
